narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management touts double‑digit PAT growth but reported PAT only rose 27% YoY in FY26
Capex commitments exceed disclosed spending; borrowings rose but free cash flow turned negative
Revenue acceleration is evident: YoY growth jumped to 57.9% in Sep 2026

bull: Revenue YoY 57.9% in Sep 2026 shows strong top‑line momentum
EBITDA grew to INR315 crores in Sep 2026, confirming operating leverage
Borrowings remain modest at D/E 0.23, indicating capacity to fund capex
bear: PAT only 31% YoY in Sep 2026, far below the INR1,100 crore FY28 target
Free cash flow turned negative in FY26, raising cash‑flow concerns
EBITDA per ton guidance (20‑24k) not substantiated by disclosed margins
